mathematics.assertion_tested: An exact MOND center with mu(y)=kappa*y^n+o(y^n), n>0, positive smooth spherical source, and physical metric-lapse acceleration has divergent Kretschmann curvature even with arbitrary slip. The proof uses the derivative-free tangential bound K>=8*(Phi'/r)^2/c^4. If rho_eff~r^m, finite leading curvature necessarily requires m>=n but that condition is not sufficient. With derivative regular variation, the sharper coefficients follow; the analytic exponential n=1 no-slip branch has R=5*C/(c^2*sqrt(r)) and K=43*C^2/(c^4*r).
